integrity: The sharp inequality and equality cases are proved analytically from Parseval, elementary modulus inequalities, and a one-variable maximization. Numerical verification is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the continuous torus and the four-term arithmetic-progression spectrum only; no finite-cyclic, arbitrary four-point, or other-exponent classification is claimed.
title: Sharp \(L^2\)-to-\(L^4\) norm for four consecutive characters
